title: spec.skill.md Phase 5a: patch_file on signals/index.md requires prior read_file
description: patch_file was called on .moeb/signals/index.md after grep_files returned the target row, but without a prior read_file. The kernel write-before-read guard rejected the call. A fallback read_file was issued and the subsequent patch_file succeeded. The Phase 5a skill instruction does not mention the pre-read requirement for signals/index.md.
proposed_resolution: Update the Phase 5a Index Update instruction in spec.skill.md to add an explicit read_file on .moeb/signals/index.md before calling patch_file.
